title: Scared to speak English? ⏲️ 6 Minute English
speaker: BBC Learning English
zh: 【BBC Learning English】害怕說英語？ ⏲️ 6分鐘英語（精選雙語跟讀教材）

cues.text: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
cues.en: Hello and welcome to 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English.
cues.zh: 您好，歡迎收看 BBC 英語學習的 6 分鐘英語。

cues.text: I'm Pippa. And I'm Beth.
cues.en: I'm Pippa. And I'm Beth.
cues.zh: 我是皮帕。我是貝絲。

cues.text: Have you ever been scared of speaking in English?
cues.en: Have you ever been scared of speaking in English?
cues.zh: 你曾經害怕用英語說話嗎？

cues.text: In this episode, we're talking about why speaking in a foreign language can be so stressful.
cues.en: In this episode, we're talking about why speaking in a foreign language can be so stressful.
cues.zh: 在本集中，我們將討論為什麼說外語會帶來如此大的壓力。

cues.text: So, Pippa, do you ever get nervous speaking in a different language?
cues.en: So, Pippa, do you ever get nervous speaking in a different language?
cues.zh: 那麼，皮帕，你在用不同的語言說話時是否會感到緊張？

cues.text: Yes, I learnt French when I was younger and I was actually quite good at it, I think,
cues.en: Yes, I learnt French when I was younger and I was actually quite good at it, I think,
cues.zh: 是的，我年輕的時候學過法語，我覺得法語其實還不錯，

cues.text: but I was really nervous when I was speaking French. How about you?
cues.en: but I was really nervous when I was speaking French. How about you?
cues.zh: 但當我說法語時我真的很緊張。你呢？

cues.text: Yeah, I've always felt like that with Spanish.
cues.en: Yeah, I've always felt like that with Spanish.
cues.zh: 是的，我對西班牙文一直有這樣的感覺。

cues.text: I am scared to speak because I don't want to make mistakes,
cues.en: I am scared to speak because I don't want to make mistakes,
cues.zh: 我不敢說話因為我不想犯錯

cues.text: even though I know it's OK to make mistakes.
cues.en: even though I know it's OK to make mistakes.
cues.zh: 儘管我知道犯錯是可以的。

cues.text: Well, in this episode of 6 Minute English, we'll be hearing about how to feel less nervous when you speak English.
cues.en: Well, in this episode of 6 Minute English, we'll be hearing about how to feel less nervous when you speak English.
cues.zh: 好吧，在這一集的 6 分鐘英語中，我們將瞭解如何在說英語時減輕緊張感。

cues.text: And as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases.
cues.en: And as usual, we'll be learning some useful new words and phrases.
cues.zh: 像往常一樣，我們將學習一些有用的新單字和短語。

cues.text: You can practise these with the quiz and worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.en: You can practise these with the quiz and worksheet on our website, bbclearningenglish.com.
cues.zh: 您可以透過我們網站 bbclearningenglish.com 上的測驗和工作表進行練習。

cues.text: But first I have a question for you, Pippa.
cues.en: But first I have a question for you, Pippa.
cues.zh: 但首先我有一個問題要問你，皮帕。

cues.text: So, English has around one million words, but on average,
cues.en: So, English has around one million words, but on average,
cues.zh: 所以，英語大約有一百萬個單詞，但平均而言，

cues.text: how many words does a typical English speaker use in daily conversation?
cues.en: how many words does a typical English speaker use in daily conversation?
cues.zh: 一個典型的說英語的人在日常對話中會使用多少個單字？

cues.text: Is it a) between 2000 and 3000?
cues.en: Is it a) between 2000 and 3000?

cues.text: b) between 20000 and 30000.
cues.en: b) between 20000 and 30000.

cues.text: Or c) between 200000 and 300000.
cues.en: Or c) between 200000 and 300000.

cues.text: I'm going to say a) 2000 to 3000.
cues.en: I'm going to say a) 2000 to 3000.

cues.text: OK. Well we will find out later in the programme.
cues.en: OK. Well we will find out later in the programme.
cues.zh: 好的。好吧，我們稍後會在節目中找到答案。

cues.text: Now, Pippa, you said you found it stressful speaking in French,
cues.en: Now, Pippa, you said you found it stressful speaking in French,
cues.zh: 現在，皮帕，你說你發現說法語有壓力，

cues.text: even though you are quite good at it.
cues.en: even though you are quite good at it.
cues.zh: 即使你很擅長。

cues.text: Now, someone else who has had this experience is Hanan Razek.
cues.en: Now, someone else who has had this experience is Hanan Razek.
cues.zh: 現在，另一個有過這種經驗的人是哈南·拉澤克(Hanan Razek)。

cues.text: Hanan is a journalist at BBC Arabic and also host of the podcast Beating Speaking Anxiety.
cues.en: Hanan is a journalist at BBC Arabic and also host of the podcast Beating Speaking Anxiety.
cues.zh: 哈南是 BBC 阿拉伯語的記者，也是播客《擊敗演講焦慮》的主持人。

cues.text: Here she is telling BBC Learning English presenter Georgie
cues.en: Here she is telling BBC Learning English presenter Georgie
cues.zh: 在這裡，她正在告訴 BBC 英語學習節目主持人 Georgie

cues.text: about speaking English.
cues.en: about speaking English.
cues.zh: 關於說英語。

cues.text: My English was actually pretty good but having conversations with people,
cues.en: My English was actually pretty good but having conversations with people,
cues.zh: 我的英語其實還不錯，但是在與人交談時，

cues.text: I found it really difficult.
cues.en: I found it really difficult.
cues.zh: 我發現這真的很難。

cues.text: So when I first joined the BBC, the Learning English team made an assessment
cues.en: So when I first joined the BBC, the Learning English team made an assessment
cues.zh: 所以當我剛加入BBC的時候，Learning English團隊做了一個評估

cues.text: of my English level, which they used to do for all new joiners
cues.en: of my English level, which they used to do for all new joiners
cues.zh: 我的英語水平，他們以前對所有新加入者都這樣做

cues.text: to see if they need any help or courses.
cues.en: to see if they need any help or courses.
cues.zh: 看看他們是否需要任何幫助或課程。

cues.text: My results were pretty good and I was fluent.
cues.en: My results were pretty good and I was fluent.
cues.zh: 我的成績很好，而且說得很流利。

cues.text: But on that very same day, leaving the building and going to get some coffee,
cues.en: But on that very same day, leaving the building and going to get some coffee,
cues.zh: 但就在同一天，離開大樓去喝咖啡時，

cues.text: I couldn't really understand what the barista was saying, and I felt pretty nervous to order coffee
cues.en: I couldn't really understand what the barista was saying, and I felt pretty nervous to order coffee
cues.zh: 我不太明白咖啡師在說什麼，點咖啡時我感到很緊張

cues.text: and was trying to stress every single word, hoping that my grammar is correct and I am pronouncing the words right.
cues.en: and was trying to stress every single word, hoping that my grammar is correct and I am pronouncing the words right.
cues.zh: 並試圖強調每一個單詞，希望我的語法是正確的，並且我的發音是正確的。

cues.text: Yeah, I'm sure that's a situation lots of people can relate to.
cues.en: Yeah, I'm sure that's a situation lots of people can relate to.
cues.zh: 是的，我相信這是很多人都能體會到的情況。

cues.text: Hanan's results on her English assessment were pretty good, but she was still pretty nervous to speak in English,
cues.en: Hanan's results on her English assessment were pretty good, but she was still pretty nervous to speak in English,
cues.zh: Hanan的英語成績不錯，但說英語還是很緊張，

cues.text: for example when ordering a coffee in English.
cues.en: for example when ordering a coffee in English.
cues.zh: 例如用英語點咖啡時。

cues.text: The modifier pretty means quite or a bit.
cues.en: The modifier pretty means quite or a bit.
cues.zh: 修飾語 Pretty 的意思是相當或一點。

cues.text: Georgie says that Hanan's experience is something that lots of people can relate to.
cues.en: Georgie says that Hanan's experience is something that lots of people can relate to.
cues.zh: 喬治說哈南的經驗是很多人都能感同身受的。

cues.text: If you relate to a situation, you know what it feels like,
cues.en: If you relate to a situation, you know what it feels like,
cues.zh: 如果你涉及到一種情況，你知道那是什麼感覺，

cues.text: usually because a similar thing has happened to you.
cues.en: usually because a similar thing has happened to you.
cues.zh: 通常是因為類似的事情發生在你身上。

cues.text: So lots of people feel nervous speaking another language,
cues.en: So lots of people feel nervous speaking another language,
cues.zh: 所以很多人在說另一種語言時感到緊張，

cues.text: even if they're good at it, like Hanan We can call this speaking anxiety.
cues.en: even if they're good at it, like Hanan We can call this speaking anxiety.
cues.zh: 即使他們很擅長，比如哈南，我們可以稱之為演講焦慮。

cues.text: Anxiety means an uncomfortable feeling or worry about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.en: Anxiety means an uncomfortable feeling or worry about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.zh: 焦慮是指對正在發生或將來可能發生的事情感到不舒服或擔憂。

cues.text: So why do so many people have anxiety about speaking a foreign language?
cues.en: So why do so many people have anxiety about speaking a foreign language?
cues.zh: 那麼為什麼這麼多人對說外語感到焦慮呢？

cues.text: Experts think it's connected to the beliefs we have about ourselves.
cues.en: Experts think it's connected to the beliefs we have about ourselves.
cues.zh: 專家認為這與我們對自己的信念有關。

cues.text: Han Luo, professor of Chinese at Lafayette College in the United States,
cues.en: Han Luo, professor of Chinese at Lafayette College in the United States,
cues.zh: 美國拉斐特學院中文教授韓羅，

cues.text: explains more to BBC Learning English presenter Georgie.
cues.en: explains more to BBC Learning English presenter Georgie.
cues.zh: 向 BBC Learning English 主持人 Georgie 解釋了更多內容。

cues.text: You know, usually the beliefs that cause anxiety, especially severe anxiety,
cues.en: You know, usually the beliefs that cause anxiety, especially severe anxiety,
cues.zh: 你知道，通常是那些導致焦慮，尤其是嚴重焦慮的信念，

cues.text: are, we call it irrational beliefs.
cues.en: are, we call it irrational beliefs.
cues.zh: 是，我們稱之為非理性信念。

cues.text: And also like, uh, some low self-perceptions, um, fear
cues.en: And also like, uh, some low self-perceptions, um, fear
cues.zh: 還有，呃，一些低自我認知，嗯，恐懼

cues.text: of negative evaluation, all those learner internal, you know, factors.
cues.en: of negative evaluation, all those learner internal, you know, factors.
cues.zh: 負面評價，所有這些學習者內部的因素。

cues.text: And Han says that learners worry about mistakes because they're scared of negative evaluation.
cues.en: And Han says that learners worry about mistakes because they're scared of negative evaluation.
cues.zh: 韓說，學習者擔心錯誤是因為他們害怕負面評價。

cues.text: In other words, that people will judge them for their mistakes and think badly of them.
cues.en: In other words, that people will judge them for their mistakes and think badly of them.
cues.zh: 換句話說，人們會因為他們的錯誤而評判他們，並對他們產生不好的看法。

cues.text: Han argues that irrational beliefs can make us anxious.
cues.en: Han argues that irrational beliefs can make us anxious.
cues.zh: 韓認為，非理性信念會讓我們感到焦慮。

cues.text: Irrational beliefs are beliefs that aren't based on things that are true.
cues.en: Irrational beliefs are beliefs that aren't based on things that are true.
cues.zh: 非理性信念是不基於真實事物的信念。

cues.text: They're not logical.
cues.en: They're not logical.
cues.zh: 他們不符合邏輯。

cues.text: Han says some people who have speaking anxiety have low self-perceptions.
cues.en: Han says some people who have speaking anxiety have low self-perceptions.
cues.zh: 韓說，一些有演講焦慮的人自我認知較低。

cues.text: Your self-perception is what you think about yourself.
cues.en: Your self-perception is what you think about yourself.
cues.zh: 你的自我認知就是你對自己的看法。

cues.text: Self-perception and irrational beliefs are both internal factors.
cues.en: Self-perception and irrational beliefs are both internal factors.
cues.zh: 自我認知和非理性信念都是內在因素。

cues.text: They come from inside your head, not from the people around you.
cues.en: They come from inside your head, not from the people around you.
cues.zh: 它們來自你的頭腦，而不是你周圍的人。

cues.text: So, for example, when you speak your first language, you might feel confident and intelligent,
cues.en: So, for example, when you speak your first language, you might feel confident and intelligent,
cues.zh: 例如，當你說你的母語時，你可能會感到自信和聰明，

cues.text: but when you speak in a new language, you make mistakes and feel less confident.
cues.en: but when you speak in a new language, you make mistakes and feel less confident.
cues.zh: 但當你用一種新語言說話時，你就會犯錯並且感到不那麼自信。

cues.text: You can't show people what you're really like, and this is frustrating.
cues.en: You can't show people what you're really like, and this is frustrating.
cues.zh: 你無法向人們展示你真正喜歡的東西，這很令人沮喪。

cues.text: But as we tell people all the time at BBC Learning English,
cues.en: But as we tell people all the time at BBC Learning English,
cues.zh: 但正如我們在 BBC Learning English 中一直告訴人們的那樣，

cues.text: mistakes are normal.
cues.en: mistakes are normal.
cues.zh: 錯誤是正常的。

cues.text: You have to try to speak, even though you make mistakes, and mistakes can be a good thing.
cues.en: You have to try to speak, even though you make mistakes, and mistakes can be a good thing.
cues.zh: 即使你犯了錯誤，你也必須嘗試說話，而錯誤可能是一件好事。

cues.text: They can help us learn.
cues.en: They can help us learn.
cues.zh: 他們可以幫助我們學習。

cues.text: And if you want more tips to improve your speaking, listen to the Beating Speaking Anxiety podcast.
cues.en: And if you want more tips to improve your speaking, listen to the Beating Speaking Anxiety podcast.
cues.zh: 如果您想了解更多提高口語的技巧，請收聽擊敗口語焦慮播客。

cues.text: There's a link in the notes below this episode.
cues.en: There's a link in the notes below this episode.
cues.zh: 本集下面的註釋中有一個連結。

cues.text: But Beth, I think it's time for the answer to your quiz question.
cues.en: But Beth, I think it's time for the answer to your quiz question.
cues.zh: 但是貝絲，我想是時候回答你的測驗問題了。

cues.text: Yes, I asked you how many words does the average English speaker use
cues.en: Yes, I asked you how many words does the average English speaker use
cues.zh: 是的，我問你說英語的人平均使用多少個單字

cues.text: in daily communication?
cues.en: in daily communication?
cues.zh: 在日常交流中？

cues.text: The answer is 20000 to 30000.
cues.en: The answer is 20000 to 30000.

cues.text: That's quite a lot. Yeah.
cues.en: That's quite a lot. Yeah.
cues.zh: 這是相當多的。是的。

cues.text: That's loads.
cues.en: That's loads.
cues.zh: 那是負載。

cues.text: OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt. Pretty can be used as a modifier to mean quite or a bit.
cues.en: OK, let's recap the vocabulary we've learnt. Pretty can be used as a modifier to mean quite or a bit.
cues.zh: 好吧，讓我們回顧一下我們學過的詞彙。 Pretty 可以用作修飾語，表示相當或一點。

cues.text: If you relate to a person or situation you understand them, usually because you've experienced something similar.
cues.en: If you relate to a person or situation you understand them, usually because you've experienced something similar.
cues.zh: 如果你與某個人或某個情況有關，你就會理解他們，通常是因為你經歷過類似的事情。

cues.text: Anxiety is feeling uncomfortable or worried about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.en: Anxiety is feeling uncomfortable or worried about something that is happening or could happen in the future.
cues.zh: 焦慮是對正在發生或將來可能發生的事情感到不舒服或擔心。

cues.text: Irrational beliefs are beliefs about something that is not true.
cues.en: Irrational beliefs are beliefs about something that is not true.
cues.zh: 非理性信念是對不真實事物的信念。

cues.text: They're not logical.
cues.en: They're not logical.
cues.zh: 他們不符合邏輯。

cues.text: Self-perception is the way you see yourself. And
cues.en: Self-perception is the way you see yourself. And
cues.zh: 自我認知是你看待自己的方式。並且

cues.text: internal means inside the body or mind.
cues.en: internal means inside the body or mind.
cues.zh: 內在是指身體或心靈內在。

cues.text: Once again, our six minutes are up.
cues.en: Once again, our six minutes are up.
cues.zh: 我們的六分鐘時間又到了。

cues.text: But if you'd like to find out more about speaking anxiety,
cues.en: But if you'd like to find out more about speaking anxiety,
cues.zh: 但如果你想了解更多關於演講焦慮的資訊

cues.text: then head over to our website, bbclearningenglish.com to find our Beating Speaking Anxiety series.
cues.en: then head over to our website, bbclearningenglish.com to find our Beating Speaking Anxiety series.
cues.zh: 然後前往我們的網站 bbclearningenglish.com 查詢我們的“擊敗演講焦慮”系列。

cues.text: There are podcasts about the things we find scary when speaking a different language,
cues.en: There are podcasts about the things we find scary when speaking a different language,
cues.zh: 有一些播客是關於我們在說不同語言時感到害怕的事情的，

cues.text: and videos with tips to help you feel more confident with speaking.
cues.en: and videos with tips to help you feel more confident with speaking.
cues.zh: 以及包含提示的影片，可幫助您在演講時更加自信。

cues.text: Thanks for joining us and goodbye.
cues.en: Thanks for joining us and goodbye.
cues.zh: 感謝您加入我們，再見。
